description: TelcoAutomationBlueprint is the Schema for the TelcoAutomationBlueprint API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: TelcoAutomationBlueprintSpec defines the desired state of TelcoAutomationBlueprint

displayName.description: Optional. Human readable name of a Blueprint.

files.description: Optional. Files present in a blueprint. When invoking UpdateBlueprint API, only the modified files should be included in this. Files that are not included in the update of a blueprint will not be changed.

content.description: Optional. The contents of a file in string format.

deleted.description: Optional. Signifies whether a file is marked for deletion.

editable.description: Optional. Indicates whether changes are allowed to a file. If the field is not set, the file cannot be edited.

path.description: Required. Path of the file in package. e.g. `gdce/v1/cluster.yaml`

labels.description: Optional. Labels are key-value attributes that can be set on a blueprint resource by the user.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The TelcoAutomationBlueprint name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

sourceBlueprint.description: Required. Immutable. The public blueprint ID from which this blueprint was created.

status.description: TelcoAutomationBlueprintStatus defines the config connector machine state of TelcoAutomationBlueprint

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the TelcoAutomationBlueprint resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

approvalState.description: Output only. Approval state of the blueprint (DRAFT, PROPOSED, APPROVED)

deploymentLevel.description: Output only. DeploymentLevel of a blueprint signifies where the blueprint will be applied. e.g. [HYDRATION, SINGLE_DEPLOYMENT, MULTI_DEPLOYMENT]

repository.description: Output only. Name of the repository where the blueprint files are stored.

revisionCreateTime.description: Output only. The timestamp that the revision was created.

revisionID.description: Output only. Immutable. The revision ID of the blueprint. A new revision is committed whenever a blueprint is approved.

rollbackSupport.description: Output only. Indicates if the deployment created from this blueprint can be rolled back.

sourceProvider.description: Output only. Source provider is the author of a public blueprint, from which this blueprint is created.

updateTime.description: Output only. The timestamp when the blueprint was updated.
